question.text: Banks are permitted to become members of the Currency Derivatives Segment subject to:

answer.text: Being a scheduled commercial bank only

explanation.text: The Logic: AD Category-I banks may become trading and clearing members of the Currency Derivatives Segment on their own account and on client account subject to fulfilling the minimum prudential requirements set by RBI/SEBI. The Trap: Not every bank can join as a member. AD Category-I banks that are urban cooperative banks or state cooperative banks can participate in the segment only as clients, not as members. Note: Member admission for banks rests on prudential criteria — net worth, capital adequacy and other RBI-supervised parameters — rather than on SEBI approval alone or an asset-size threshold.
